provenance_review.publisher_claim: CC-BY-4.0; permissively licensed public web/academic sources and automated PII filtering. These claims do not independently clear each original document.
provenance_review.finding: The inspected shard provides no original-source URL or per-document license column; none of its image.path values is an HTTP(S) URL. This is not proof that provenance cannot be recovered elsewhere, but this review did not resolve original-document permissions, privacy or label accuracy. No source approval granted.

quarantine_reason: A reviewed development annotation appears to contain a filled health questionnaire; real versus illustrative status is unknown. Do not use any page from this source for training or publication without a new documented source/privacy review.
scope: The existing 20-page development sample only. Remaining sources are pending review, not approved simply because their normalized annotations render.
final_test_policy: All source groups encountered in the 20-page audit are development-only, including other pages of those sources. Source IDs alone do not prove deduplication.
enforcement_limit: scripts/corpus_preflight.py enforces source review, exact reviewed target hashes, quarantine and split/duplicate checks in its bounded preflight. It is not a system-wide prohibition or a training loader; native training APIs are not guarded by this tool. No real-data training manifest exists yet.
